mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP3A4) which may alter ginseng metabolism; ginseng may also have mild antiplatelet properties increasing bleeding risk when combined with cimetidine's potential effects on coagulation.
action: Monitor for increased ginseng effects and bleeding signs; consider dose adjustment of either agent or alternative H2-blocker if excessive ginseng effects occur.
